summaries.en: U.S. President Donald Trump stated that recent military strikes against Iran would 'not last too long' but warned of readiness for additional attacks, claiming Iran was rebuilding military equipment and urging the Iranian people to revolt.
summaries.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普表示，近期对伊朗的军事打击不会持续太久，但他警告称已准备好随时进行进一步攻击，并声称伊朗正在重建军事装备，同时呼吁伊朗人民奋起反抗其政权。
